title: Review workflow: git safe.directory for agent containers
summary: The review workflow runs several agent containers (Codex, Claude, OpenRouter, verifier) that operate on the checked-out PR and base trees mounted at /pr and /base. Git refuses to read repositories owned by a different uid than the container user, so each job now writes a small gitconfig declaring /pr and /base as safe.directory and bind-mounts it read-only at /home/dev/.gitconfig inside the container. Nothing else about the jobs changes: the same images, mounts, tokens and working directories are used, and the gitconfig is produced in the same out/ directory that is already mounted into the container.
